messages: the 1.64.0 update for the allflame league is now available
it includes updated quest-reward info, which is very important if your build uses the faster attacks/casting support(s)
it also includes a routing change for the fairgraves fight in act 1 (based on ZiggyD's preview video)
these changes will be applied the next time you reset the guide
as with every league-start patch: if features don't activate correctly, you'll have to recalibrate their screen-checks
